description: Maine's Lobster Fishing Community Confronts Their Changing Climate is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by University of Maine | Cooperative Extension; Maine Sea Grant; Social and Environmental Research Institute. Participatory planning and system dynamics modeling help fishermen in coastal Maine make decisions to improve their bottom lines. Coverage: Maine (2016). The toolkit gives Maine as the location, 2016 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
